title: The Number Nobody Published
gallery_text: At the published office rent, not one building in the district converts. Sixty-seven of them convert once you decide what a landlord actually collects, and that is the one figure in the deal nobody publishes.
description:
One value changed from the defaults: the discount between asking rent and effective rent, from zero to a quarter.

The office rent in this model is sourced - $54 a square foot a year, Manhattan class B and C, from the Comptroller's May 2024 spotlight. It is an asking rent. What a landlord collects after free months and fit-out money is less, and no published series for that was found. So the sandbox subtracts nothing by default, and at the default the map is entirely blue: nothing clears the deal, in any year.

Move the discount to 25% and sixty-seven buildings convert. Nothing about the buildings changed. What changed is a number that is not in any table, chosen by whoever is making the argument.

The version of this sandbox before September had a 39% haircut already applied, in a comment in the source, to an office rent that was not published either. It converted 29% of the district and looked completely normal.
